status: profile-only revision before any off-trajectory step response
reason_for_revision: The fixed 300 s high/low pulses in preregistration.json converged back to nearly identical coolant slope, CDU state, and flow by their 32 C match. Their feasibility trace and selection are retained. The frozen model, matching tolerance, branch protocol, and metrics are unchanged.
selection_rule: For each profile, after return to 10.86 kW and at least one full 20 s baseline interval, find the first sample within plus/minus 0.1 C of 32 C; among that sample and eligible samples in the next 200 s choose the closest to 32 C, breaking ties by earliest time. If any profile lacks a match, record feasibility failure and do not run its step branch.

profiles.constant_hold: 10.86 kW to all racks from cold initialization until temperature match, no power switch
profiles.late_high_then_base: 10.86 kW to all racks until 7200 s; then 20.0 kW to all racks until rack 1 coolant first reaches at least 31.9 C; return all racks to 10.86 kW and apply selection rule
profiles.low_then_raised_base: 10.86 kW to all racks until 600 s; then 5.0 kW to all racks until rack 1 coolant first reaches at most 32.1 C; return all racks to 10.86 kW and apply selection rule

branch_protocol_and_model: Identical to preregistration.json and frozen_coolant_only_model.json: same saved state to 3600 s control and rack-1 40 kW step, 20 s ticks, 290 K ambient, 10.86 kW current power; no refitting or metric selection after outcomes.
report: Publish every preconditioning attempt, selected temperatures, slopes, CDU supply/return, flow, branch outputs, frozen-model predictions, signed residuals, and repeat variation. If matched states remain nearly identical in current plant observables, report limited discrimination rather than claiming temperature sufficiency.
stop_gate: No Task 1.5 acceptance change, Task 1.6, history matching, scheduler, or RL work.
